headline: Nvidia director Mark Stevens sold about $946 million of company shares in the third quarter.
score_reason: Filing-based figures from one outlet, with no stated reason; pool score 5 kept.
importance_line: It matters most to investors who watch insider sales, since large sales by a board member draw attention, though the filings give no reason and Stevens still holds a large stake.
summary: GuruFocus reports, citing filings compiled by Washington Service, that Nvidia director Mark Stevens sold about 4.24 million shares of the AI chipmaker worth $946.63 million in the third quarter. The filings give no reason for the sales, and Stevens still holds a large Nvidia stake directly and through trusts, so the sales are not clear evidence of a change in his long-term view.
notes: Bloomberg (403) and Quartz (403) originals blocked; read on GuruFocus, which cites filings compiled by Washington Service. The pool's 'tops AI sellers' claim is not in the text read and is not used.
